subject: Every GitHub backup must include local message-board updates through a declared cutoff
body: Before any GitHub backup push, the relevant local message-board records must already be persisted and read back. Each backup must include all project/message changes through a declared local cutoff and must be followed by a local BackupReceipt identifying the Git commit SHA and cutoff. A GitHub push that omits newer local board messages is incomplete and must not be marked BACKED_UP.
